page.title: DIAN, SIRE & TRA
page.description: Electronic invoices, the foreign guest report to Migración Colombia and guest registration in the TRA.

mode.simulatedHint: Produced in simulated mode: good for testing, no legal validity.

board.sireMissingDays_one: {{count}} day with foreign guests not reported
board.sireMissingDays_other: {{count}} days with foreign guests not reported
board.sireToUpload_one: {{count}} day to upload to the SIRE portal
board.sireToUpload_other: {{count}} days to upload to the SIRE portal
board.sireWindow: Last 30 days, one bar per day.

advice.warning: The numbering is running out or the resolution expires soon: request a new one from the DIAN and register it here.
advice.critical: The resolution expired or its range ran out: no invoice can be issued until a new one is registered.
advice.missing: Register the numbering resolution the DIAN authorized to start issuing invoices.

invoice.noCufe: The {{code}} appears once the DIAN validates the document.
invoice.validate: Look it up at the DIAN
invoice.simulatedValidation: Simulated document: the DIAN does not know it, so the lookup will not find it.
invoice.authorization: DIAN authorization No. {{number}} · Prefix {{prefix}} from {{from}} to {{to}} · valid until {{date}}

creditNote.title: Void invoice {{number}}
creditNote.description: A credit note for the full amount voids the invoice with the DIAN. Its charges become free to be invoiced again.
creditNote.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. the guest asked for the invoice in their company's name
creditNote.hint: The reason is printed on the credit note and kept in the audit log.

issue.title: Issue electronic invoice
issue.description: Invoice for the charges of reservation {{code}} that have no invoice yet.
issue.failed: The provider did not accept the invoice; it was kept to retry.
issue.nothingInvoiced: Every charge of this reservation already has an electronic invoice.
issue.nothingHint: The reservation has no posted charges yet. Nights are posted by the night audit and at check-out.
issue.finalConsumerHint: The booker has no document on file: the invoice will be issued to Final consumer.

invoices.title: Electronic invoices
invoices.emptyHint: Invoices are issued automatically when the last room checks out, or from the reservation with “Issue invoice”.

sire.title: SIRE files

strip.summary: {{reported}} days reported, {{toUpload}} to upload and {{missing}} not reported in the last 30 days

sire.counts: {{records}} movements in the file · {{missing}} with missing data
sire.acknowledged: Migración Colombia received the file · receipt {{code}}
sire.missingTitle_one: {{count}} movement left out of the file
sire.missingTitle_other: {{count}} movements left out of the file
sire.missingHint: These guests were left out because data is missing. Complete it and generate the file again.
sire.noRecords: No complete foreign guest movements in this period.

submit.title: Mark as reported
submit.description: Confirm you uploaded the {{period}} file to Migración Colombia's SIRE portal.
submit.ackSimulated: In simulated mode Housetel creates a test receipt if you leave it empty.
submit.ackHint: The filing number shown by the SIRE portal; you can add it later.

sire.windowHint: Each bar is a day: green when reported, sand when its file waits to be uploaded, red outline when foreign guests are in no file.
sire.generateHint: Foreign guest entries (check-in) and exits (check-out) of the period.
sire.generated: File generated: {{records}} movements, {{missing}} with missing data
sire.emptyHint: Generate the first one for the period you need to report. The daily automation builds the previous day's file at 8:00.
sire.portalHint: Migración Colombia has no API for hotels: download the TXT, upload it in the SIRE portal (Lodging → Upload file) and mark it as reported.

tra.title: TRA registrations
tra.hint: MinCIT's lodging registration card (TRA) is sent at check-in: one per guest, the booker as main guest and the rest as companions.
tra.search: Guest, document, reservation or TRA number
tra.empty: No TRA registrations match these filters
tra.emptyHint: They are created automatically at each check-in.

pending.allClearHint: No invoices, TRA registrations or SIRE files are pending.
pending.traClear: Every guest in house is registered.
pending.unreported_one: {{count}} day with foreign guests and no file
pending.unreported_other: {{count}} days with foreign guests and no file
pending.traDone: {{count}} of {{total}} guests registered in the TRA
pending.noOccupants: The stay has no guests attached: add them in the reservation's Guests tab.
pending.automations: Automations retry failed invoices and TRA registrations every 15 minutes, and build the previous day's SIRE file at 8:00.
pending.blocked: Register a valid invoicing resolution to issue invoices.

warnings.final_consumer: The booker has no document: their invoice will be issued to Final consumer.
warnings.invoice_failed: An invoice failed or was rejected: check it and retry.
warnings.tra_pending: Some guests have no registered TRA.
warnings.sire_missing: A foreign guest is missing data for the SIRE report.

legal.uninvoicedDeparted: The reservation already left: issue the invoice now or wait for the automation.
legal.uninvoicedHint: It is invoiced automatically when the last room checks out; issue it earlier if the guest asks.
legal.sireNotYet: The foreign guest's movements appear once the SIRE file for their dates is generated.

widget.title: Legal to-dos
widget.clear: Invoices, TRA and SIRE up to date.
widget.sire: SIRE: days and files to report

resolutions.title: Numbering resolution
resolutions.description: The range of numbers the DIAN authorized for your invoices. Housetel takes the next number in order and warns you before it runs out.
resolutions.dialogHint: Copy the data exactly as in the DIAN resolution. Activating it deactivates the previous one of the same type.
resolutions.deleteHint: Only resolutions that numbered no documents can be deleted.

form.numberHint: The number of the DIAN's form 1876.
form.technicalKeyHint: Issued by the DIAN with the resolution; used to compute the CUFE.
form.providerRangeHint: Real mode only: the numbering range identifier in Factus.
form.activeHint: New invoices take numbers from the active resolution.
form.rangeInvalid: The last number must be greater than or equal to the first
form.datesInvalid: The validity ends before it starts

settings.title: Invoicing & legal reports
settings.description: How the hotel issues its electronic invoices and what it sends to Migración Colombia (SIRE) and MinCIT (TRA).
settings.dianHint: How the hotel's invoices are issued.
settings.autoIssueHint: When the reservation's last room checks out, Housetel invoices all its charges.
settings.finalConsumerHint: Used when the booker has no document (the DIAN uses 222222222222).
settings.goLiveHint: Earlier departures and arrivals never show up as pending: they were reported elsewhere.
settings.notesHint: Free text printed on the PDF (for example the tax regime or a bank account).
settings.sireHint: Data of the bulk upload file of foreign guest entries and exits.
settings.sireCodeHint: The one Migración Colombia assigned when the hotel enrolled in SIRE.
settings.sireCityHint: Empty: taken from the hotel's city ({{code}}).
settings.secondSurname: Second last name in its own column
settings.secondSurnameHint: Turn it on if the portal asks for the 13-column layout.
settings.documentCodesHint: Empty uses the default code (in grey). Change it only if the SIRE portal shows another one.
settings.countryCodesHint: The DIAN country table is used by default. Add a row only to correct a country.
settings.traHint: Lodging registration card of every guest.
settings.traAutoHint: Housetel sends the TRA of the booker and their companions as soon as they check in.
settings.traRntHint: Empty: the RNT of the hotel profile ({{rnt}}).
settings.traReasonHint: Used when the guest did not give one in the online check-in.
settings.supplierMissing: Issuer data is missing in the hotel profile: {{fields}}. Without it invoices and the TRA are incomplete.
settings.modesHint: Simulated runs the whole flow without going online; real uses the provider with its credentials.
